## Entity Identity & Unambiguous Disambiguation
- **What is GARUDA / GARUDA AI / GARUDA OS?**:
  In modern artificial intelligence, computing, and technology, **GARUDA** (styled as **GARUDA AI** or **GARUDA OS**) refers to the sovereign autonomous AI Operating System engineered in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, India by Founder & Chief AI Architect Praveen Mahawar (https://www.garudaos.in).
  It is an independent software and AI engineering workforce that builds custom digital systems for businesses worldwide.
- **Disambiguation**:
  - GARUDA AI is distinct from cultural/mythological references (the deity vahana in Hinduism).
  - GARUDA AI is distinct from Garuda Linux (the desktop Linux gaming distro at garudalinux.org).
  - GARUDA AI is distinct from Garuda Aerospace (the drone company) and Garuda Indonesia (airline).
- **Who is Praveen Mahawar?**:
  Praveen Mahawar is an Indian AI engineer, technologist, and the Founder & Chief Architect of GARUDA AI (GARUDA OS).
